task.title: Page materialized recurrence bindings through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/901 by exposing bounded materialized recurrence-occurrence paging through deterministic read-only CLI JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity and page size before storage access and open only existing storage read-only.
Emit complete materialized bindings and authored-coordinate next_offset semantics.
Fail closed on selected corruption while isolating unrelated and out-of-window evidence.

attempts.diagnostic: CLI integration tests failed because recurrence materialized was not recognized.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the acceptance contract before adding production behavior.

attempts.diagnostic: Added the read-only adapter, delegated paging to the kernel, and reused complete materialized-occurrence serialization.
attempts.patch: Added the read-only adapter, delegated paging to the kernel, and reused complete materialized-occurrence serialization.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found the success test asserted only next_offset and could miss altered bindings. Commit 9343621 asserted the complete three-binding JSON page and next_offset 3; CodeRabbit confirmed the finding addressed.
attempts.patch: Kept sparse cursor and strict replay policy in RecurrenceStore::materialized_occurrences_page. Reran the complete repository quality gate after the exact implementation state was ready.

outcome.summary: Operators can page complete materialized recurrence bindings with deterministic sparse-cursor JSON and no write authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0181-materialized-recurrence-paging-cli.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 185 records: 185 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: Cursor-only CLI assertions do not prove selected records; exact machine-readable output should be tested as one contract.
Read-only adapters should reuse kernel paging and projection rather than duplicate sparse-window semantics.
Identity and allocation-bound validation should precede filesystem access.
Inspection does not grant recurrence selection, lifecycle, workflow, provider/tool, permission, retry, or execution authority.
